verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ imu nana ejobi vwọ wan nu Ọghẹnẹ da davwe Ebraham ni, ọ da ta kẹ, Ebraham; O de nyo nẹ, Mẹvwẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: re imu nana ejobi vwo wan nu oghene da davwe ebraham ni o da ta ke ebraham o de nyo ne mevwe na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Reyọ ọmọ wẹn ọmọ wẹn ọvuọvo na Aizik, rẹ ivun rọye vwerha owẹ na, re wọ yanran kpo otọ ri Moriah, rẹ wọ dia Etiyin de vwo ze izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ vwẹ enu rẹ ugbenu ọvo na ri mi che dje kẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta reyo omo wen omo wen ovuovo na aizik re ivun roye vwerha owe na re wo yanran kpo oto ri moriah re wo dia etiyin de vwo ze izobo re etorhe vwe enu re ugbenu ovo na ri mi che dje ke we

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham de vrẹn vwẹ irhiọke ride, ọ da jẹn ufi phihọ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rọye, ọ da reyọ emeshare rọye ivẹ vwọ boma, kugbe ọmọ rọye Aizik, o de kru ekrirhe re ze izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ na, o de vrẹn vwo kpo asan rẹ Ọghẹnẹ dje kẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham de vren vwe irhioke ride o da jen ufi phiho eketekete roye o da reyo emeshare roye ive vwo boma kugbe omo roye aizik o de kru ekrirhe re ze izobo re etorhe na o de vren vwo kpo asan re oghene dje ke na

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha Ebraham da kparo ọ da mrẹ asan na vwẹ ogboko.
verses.text_romanized: vwe ede re erha ebraham da kparo o da mre asan na vwe ogboko

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham da ta kẹ emeshare rọye na, We mudia etinẹ kẹrẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ na, mẹvwẹ vẹ ọmọ na ke yanran kpo oboyi kpo ẹga rere avwanre ki rhivwi bru ovwan rhe.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham da ta ke emeshare roye na we mudia etine kere eketekete na mevwe ve omo na ke yanran kpo oboyi kpo ega rere avwanre ki rhivwi bru ovwan rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da reyọ ekrirhe re vọ izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ na, o de muo kpahọ ọmọ rọye Aizik, ọ da yọnrọn utuerhanre kugbe aphia vwẹ obọ. Kọye ayen ivẹ na de ku usun phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da reyo ekrirhe re vo izobo re etorhe na o de muo kpaho omo roye aizik o da yonron utuerhanre kugbe aphia vwe obo koye ayen ive na de ku usun phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Aizik da ta kẹ Ebraham rẹ ọsẹ rọye, Ọsẹ mẹ; O de nyo nẹ, Mẹvwẹ na mọmẹ, Ọ da ta, Nighe, erhanre kugbe irhe, ẹkẹvuọvo kẹ egbo rẹ izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ na kẹ ọrhọ?
verses.text_romanized: aizik da ta ke ebraham re ose roye ose me o de nyo ne mevwe na mome o da ta nighe erhanre kugbe irhe ekevuovo ke egbo re izobo re etorhe na ke orho

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da ta, Ọghẹnẹ ọvo che bibi egbo rẹ izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ na rhe ọmọ mẹ. Kọye ayen ivẹ na de ku usun họ.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta oghene ovo che bibi egbo re izobo re etorhe na rhe omo me koye ayen ive na de ku usun ho

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ayen rhi vwo te asan rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ta kẹ na, Ebraham da so agbada vwẹ Etiyin, ọ da rhuẹrẹ irhe na phihọ, ọ da gba Aizik rẹ ọmọ rọye na o de muo kpahe enu rẹ agbada na, rọ enu rẹ irhe na.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ayen rhi vwo te asan re oghene ta ke na ebraham da so agbada vwe etiyin o da rhuere irhe na phiho o da gba aizik re omo roye na o de muo kpahe enu re agbada na ro enu re irhe na

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham da kpare obọ, ọ da reyọ aphia ro che vwo bru ọmọ rọye na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham da kpare obo o da reyo aphia ro che vwo bru omo roye na

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo de se nẹ obo odjuvwu rhe, ọ da ta, Ebraham! Ebraham! O de nyo nẹ, Mẹvwẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo amakashe re orovwohwo de se ne obo odjuvwu rhe o da ta ebraham ebraham o de nyo ne mevwe na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Wọ ghwe obọ kpahe ọmọ na eyẹ wo ru emuọvo kẹ-ẹ, kidie Ọnana Me vwọ riẹn nu wọ djẹ oshọ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ, ru wọ vwẹ ọmọ wẹn na, ọmọ vuọvo wẹn na vwọ djahe obuko kẹ vwẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta wo ghwe obo kpahe omo na eye wo ru emuovo ke e kidie onana me vwo rien nu wo dje osho re oghene ru wo vwe omo wen na omo vuovo wen na vwo djahe obuko ke vwe e

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da kpare opharo, o vwo ni, obuko rọye ọ da mrẹ egbo, rẹ ighoro rọye gbahọ etu, Ebraham da yanran ra reyọ egbo na, kọye o vwo ze izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ vwẹ ẹdia rẹ ọmọ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da kpare opharo o vwo ni obuko roye o da mre egbo re ighoro roye gbaho etu ebraham da yanran ra reyo egbo na koye o vwo ze izobo re etorhe vwe edia re omo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Ebraham de se odẹ rẹ asan na Ọrovwohwo re sa kẹ: eriyin ọ epha rhi te nonẹ na, Vwẹ enu rẹ ugbenu rẹ Ọrovwohwo Etiyin a da mrẹ.
verses.text_romanized: koye ebraham de se ode re asan na orovwohwo re sa ke eriyin o epha rhi te none na vwe enu re ugbenu re orovwohwo etiyin a da mre

verses.text_urhobo: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo da rhoma se obọ rivẹ nẹ obo odjuvwu rhe,
verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo da rhoma se obo rive ne obo odjuvwu rhe

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ta, Me vwẹ oma mẹ duvwu iyori, eriyin Ọrovwohwo tare, fikiridie wo ru Ọnana, wọ sa vwẹ ọmọ wẹn, ọmọ vuọvo wẹn na vwọ djahe obuko kẹ vwẹ-ẹ,
verses.text_romanized: o da ta me vwe oma me duvwu iyori eriyin orovwohwo tare fikiridie wo ru onana wo sa vwe omo wen omo vuovo wen na vwo djahe obuko ke vwe e

verses.text_urhobo: Ki mi bruphihọ kẹ wẹ, ki mi ru uvwiẹ wẹn buphihọ kiri isio rẹ obo odjuvwu kiri ibiekpẹn re orhoma rẹ urhie. Uvwiẹ wẹn ke cha vwẹ anurhoro rẹ ivwighrẹ rayen riuku,
verses.text_romanized: ki mi bruphiho ke we ki mi ru uvwie wen buphiho kiri isio re obo odjuvwu kiri ibiekpen re orhoma re urhie uvwie wen ke cha vwe anurhoro re ivwighre rayen riuku

verses.text_urhobo: vwẹ oma rẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ọye ẹgborho rẹ akpọ na ejobi wan vwo ebruphihọ kẹ oma rẹ ayen, fikiridie wo mu ọghọ kẹ urhuru mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oma re uvwie wen oye egborho re akpo na ejobi wan vwo ebruphiho ke oma re ayen fikiridie wo mu ogho ke urhuru me

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham de rhivwi bru emeshare rọye ra, ayen da yan usun kpo Bẹẹrsheba; Ebraham da dia Bẹẹrsheba.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham de rhivwi bru emeshare roye ra ayen da yan usun kpo beersheba ebraham da dia beersheba

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ imu nana ejobi vwọ wan nu, a da ta kẹ Ebraham, Nighe, Milkah rhoma rhi vwiẹ emọ kẹ Nahọr rẹ oniọvo wẹn,
verses.text_romanized: oke re imu nana ejobi vwo wan nu a da ta ke ebraham nighe milkah rhoma rhi vwie emo ke nahor re oniovo wen

verses.text_urhobo: Uz rẹ ọmọkpako, Buz rẹ oniọvo rọye, Kemuẹl ọsẹ rẹ Aram,
verses.text_romanized: uz re omokpako buz re oniovo roye kemuel ose re aram

verses.text_urhobo: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaf, kugbe Bẹtuẹl.
verses.text_romanized: kesed hazo pildash jidlaf kugbe betuel

verses.text_urhobo: Bẹtuẹl kọye ọsẹ ri Rebeka. Enana ẹrenren na Milkah vwiẹ kẹ Nahọr oniọvo rẹ Ebraham.
verses.text_romanized: betuel koye ose ri rebeka enana erenren na milkah vwie ke nahor oniovo re ebraham

verses.text_urhobo: Ọsẹ rọye re se Reumah de rhe vwiẹ Teban, Gaham Tahash, kugbe Maʼakah.
verses.text_romanized: ose roye re se reumah de rhe vwie teban gaham tahash kugbe ma'akah

headings.text_urhobo: A vuẹ Ebraham nẹ ọ vwẹ Aizik ze Izobo
headings.text_romanized: a vue ebraham ne o vwe aizik ze izobo
